meta_description: 3,835 likes, 29 comments - nigellalawson on October 21, 2026: "This week’s Technical Challenge on #GBBO was a simple affair — a good, old-fashioned Bread and Butter Pudding — and my recipe has no bells and whistles, though you’re free to fiddle with it as you like. To get my pleasingly (to me) plain Jane recipe, just click on link in bio. You can also find it in my Highlights🩵🍞🩵".
